summaryZh: 沿物体原有分区铺设细金属丝与饱满珐琅釉色，保留轮廓、开口和接触关系，呈现有重量的手工器物质感。
summaryEn: Recast the subject with fine metal partitions and pooled enamel while preserving its silhouette, openings, and physical contacts.
samplePrompt: Natural editorial photograph of one plain cream ceramic jug with two small loop handles, beside one green pear on a pale limestone windowsill. Jug on the left, pear lower right, soft morning window light from the left, quiet gray plaster background, eye-level three-quarter view. Both objects fully visible with breathing room. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Real photography, no illustration, no text, no logo, no watermark.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: two separate objects. One upright rounded jug occupies the left two-thirds; two loop handles flank its shoulder and an oval mouth opens at the top. One pear sits lower right. Both rest on one horizontal sill with distinct contact shadows. Verify counts, visible handles, and spacing against the generated source before publishing.
mediumAnchor: Fired vitreous enamel separated by slender metal cloisons fitted to the existing object's surfaces.

fragments.text: Recast existing solid surfaces as fired cloisonne enamel with slender raised metal partitions; keep all original openings and object boundaries.
Use deep teal, warm ivory, and muted brass; derive secondary enamel cells from source colors rather than adding new motifs.
Let thin metal wires follow existing contour changes and visible surface divisions; avoid decorative flowers, symbols, or invented borders.
Show gently pooled glassy enamel, tiny edge menisci, and restrained firing variation within each cell.
Retain the source light direction; enamel catches small rounded highlights while metal partitions produce narrow brighter accents.
Keep the source framing, object count, silhouette, relative size, negative space, and support contacts.
Wrap partitions continuously around curved surfaces without bridging holes or floating above the object.
Resolve as a believable crafted object with controlled gloss and no added display stand or ornamental setting.

preserve: Object count, silhouette, openings, handles, and support contacts.
Relative placement and source camera viewpoint.
Recognizable subject identity and existing negative space.
negative: Lettering, logos, watermarks, floral decoration, or unrelated symbols.
Extra handles, filled openings, displaced shadows, or floating wire.
Uniform plastic shine or painted-on flat gold lines.
acceptanceZh: 主体数量、开口及把手形状与原图一致。
金属丝贴合体表，不跨越空洞或漂浮。
釉面分区来自原有结构，无新增装饰图案。
釉面与金属反光有差异，光向保持一致。
acceptanceEn: Subject counts, openings, and handle shapes match the source.
Metal partitions follow surfaces without floating or crossing holes.
Enamel cells follow existing structure without added decorative motifs.
Enamel and metal reflect differently under the original light direction.
geometryNoteZh: 仅改变实体表面材质；不重构轮廓、开口、数量或摆放。
geometryNoteEn: Change solid-surface material only; preserve silhouettes, openings, counts, and placement.

summaryZh: 把主体实体转换为有厚度的透明浇铸玻璃，通过折射、边缘积色和柔和焦散表达体积，完整保留原有形状与空间关系。
summaryEn: Turn solid subject surfaces into thick cast glass with restrained refraction, edge color, and caustics while retaining recognizable geometry.
samplePrompt: Natural product photograph of one unbranded cylindrical manual coffee grinder on a matte warm-gray table. A short crank extends right from its lid and ends in a dark wooden knob; exactly five coffee beans lie separately at the front left. Soft slanting daylight enters from upper left. Plain background, three-quarter eye-level view, full object and crank visible. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. No text, logo, watermark, or illustration.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one upright cylindrical grinder, one attached crank extending right with one knob, and exactly five loose beans at front left. The lid, cylinder, and knob remain distinguishable. The grinder contacts a single tabletop. Verify the five-bean count and crank geometry after source generation.
mediumAnchor: Thick transparent cast glass with smooth broad surfaces, subtle trapped microbubbles, and physically plausible refraction.

fragments.text: Transform existing solid subject surfaces into transparent cast glass; preserve each part's thickness, silhouette, attachment, and opening.
Use nearly colorless glass with pale aqua edges and faint warm reflections sampled from the source environment.
Define contours through doubled refractive edges and thickness transitions, never with drawn black outlines.
Add sparse microscopic bubbles within the glass and subtle casting irregularity, avoiding cracks or large inclusions.
Preserve illumination direction; create restrained caustics on the existing support and stronger reflections at glancing angles.
Retain framing, part count, placement, camera angle, and source negative space.
Refract the existing background through transparent volumes; do not invent objects, internal machinery, or decorative inserts.
Balance transparency with readable volume; retain clear edges, grounded shadows, and believable local optical distortion.

preserve: Recognizable outline, component attachments, and empty openings.
Object positions, scale, support plane, and source viewpoint.
Existing background content, visible through refracted volumes.
negative: Opaque plastic, frosted opacity over the entire subject, or mirror chrome.
Invented inclusions, internal machinery, extra objects, or enlarged bubbles.
Broken silhouettes, disconnected parts, text, logos, or watermarks.
acceptanceZh: 主体轮廓及部件连接关系与原图一致。
玻璃有厚度，透明区域能看到合理折射。
焦散仅落在原有承托面，方向符合光源。
无新增内部结构、装饰物或大气泡。
acceptanceEn: The silhouette and component connections match the source.
Transparent regions show thickness and plausible refraction.
Caustics remain on existing support surfaces and follow the light.
No invented internal structures, ornaments, or large bubbles appear.
geometryNoteZh: 保留实体几何；透明化引起的局部折射可见，但不改变物体边界和部件数量。
geometryNoteEn: Preserve solid geometry; allow local optical refraction without changing object boundaries or component counts.

summaryZh: 将主体拆解为少量互相咬合的色面，在局部叠合正侧视角与转折面，保留核心识别特征、主体数量和主要空间位置。
summaryEn: Rebuild the subject from interlocking planes and limited simultaneous viewpoints while keeping its identity, count, and spatial anchors legible.
samplePrompt: Natural environmental portrait of one adult with short dark hair standing beside a small olive tree in a sunlit courtyard, holding one closed plain ochre book against the chest with both hands. Three-quarter face looking slightly left, simple blue shirt, full upper body visible, cream stucco wall behind. Soft late-afternoon light, realistic skin and anatomy. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. No lettering, logos, watermark, or art treatment.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one person with one head, two hands holding one rectangular book against the torso; a small olive tree stands to the right. The face turns slightly left, shirt forms a blue torso mass, and the courtyard wall is a broad light background. Verify hand visibility and tree placement against the final source.
mediumAnchor: Opaque painted planes using restrained simultaneous viewpoints and interlocking angular color masses.

fragments.text: Reconstruct the scene as interlocking opaque painted planes with a limited blend of frontal and three-quarter views.
Use muted ultramarine, ochre, and chalk tones; retain source color roles as identity anchors.
Use selective angular seams to articulate major volume changes; avoid outlining every small source detail.
Give planes a dry mineral-paint surface with subtle brush drag and slight tonal variation.
Translate source light into coherent light and dark planes instead of photorealistic shading.
Keep subject count, major positions, framing, and contact relationships; permit bounded local viewpoint overlap within each subject.
Preserve key identity cues, pose, and object-contact relationships without duplicating complete subjects, faces, limbs, or components.
Resolve larger planes first; keep readable figure-ground separation and a few deliberate areas of visual rest.

preserve: Subject count and major spatial anchors.
Recognizable facial identity, pose, and object contacts.
Dominant source color roles and framing.
negative: Extra heads, hands, bodies, or duplicated complete objects.
Unrecognizable random polygons or uniformly shattered tiny facets.
Text, signatures, logos, watermarks, or borrowed motifs.
acceptanceZh: 主体数量及主要摆放位置不变。
局部正侧视角可叠合，但不多出完整五官组或肢体。
关键面部、姿态和持物关系仍可辨认。
色面具有主次与体积转折，不成为均匀碎片。
acceptanceEn: Subject count and major positions remain unchanged.
Local viewpoint overlaps do not create complete extra faces or limbs.
Key facial, pose, and held-object relationships remain recognizable.
Plane hierarchy conveys volume rather than uniform fragmentation.
geometryNoteZh: 允许主体内部局部折面与有限正侧视角叠合；不允许复制完整主体或破坏关键接触关系。
geometryNoteEn: Allow local faceting and bounded viewpoint overlap inside subjects; do not duplicate whole subjects or break key contacts.

summaryZh: 把明暗与体积转折重绘为连续等值带，线条沿主体表面流动，利用疏密与色阶建立深度，保留外轮廓和主要结构。
summaryEn: Translate tonal and volume changes into continuous contour bands whose spacing and color steps preserve the subject's silhouette and structure.
samplePrompt: Natural landscape photograph of a small tidal cove at low tide. One large rounded rock stands near lower center in shallow clear water, a curving sandbar runs behind it from left to right, and three distant rounded hills meet a pale sky. Soft overcast daylight, detailed wet sand and calm water, full rock visible. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. No people, text, logos, watermark, or illustration.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one dominant rounded foreground rock, a shallow water basin, one curved middle-distance sandbar, and three distant hill masses below the sky. The rock is separated from the sandbar by water; horizon lies in the upper third. Verify the hill count and actual shore curve after generation.
mediumAnchor: Continuous topographic-style contour bands derived from image luminance and perceived surface volume, without labels or cartographic symbols.

fragments.text: Repaint source forms as nested contour bands derived from their luminance and perceived depth, without literal map labels.
Use deep blue-green, warm sand, and pale mist in stepped tonal intervals that preserve source light-dark hierarchy.
Let continuous isolines wrap around major forms; increase density near steep tonal transitions and open spacing across calm areas.
Use clean matte bands with slight paper grain; avoid embossed relief, shiny plastic, or photographic texture overlays.
Express lighting through band values and spacing while retaining the original broad illumination direction.
Keep outer silhouettes, horizon placement, foreground-background order, and the major shoreline geometry.
Simplify small textures into coherent bands; keep key separations between subjects, support surfaces, and background readable.
Maintain balanced band widths and clear subject recognition; remove accidental tangencies and distracting isolated contour fragments.

preserve: Outer silhouettes, subject count, horizon, and major boundaries.
Foreground-background order and dominant tonal hierarchy.
Distinct separations between adjacent source subjects.
negative: Map labels, legends, coordinates, arrows, or invented geographic symbols.
Random concentric circles unrelated to source form.
Lost subject boundaries, duplicated landmarks, text, logos, or watermarks.
acceptanceZh: 主体外轮廓、远近关系及主要分界仍清晰。
等值带顺应原图结构，不是随机同心圆。
线密度和色阶共同表达体积与明暗。
画面不包含地图标注、数字或新增地形。
acceptanceEn: Outer silhouettes, depth order, and main boundaries stay clear.
Contour bands follow source structure rather than arbitrary concentric circles.
Band density and color steps jointly describe volume and light.
No map labels, numbers, or invented terrain are added.
geometryNoteZh: 允许将内部纹理简化为等值带；保持外轮廓、主体数量和主要空间分区。
geometryNoteEn: Allow internal texture simplification into contour bands while retaining outer silhouettes, counts, and major spatial regions.

summaryZh: 以半透明青瓷釉覆盖主体外表，通过釉层积色与细密开片呈现温润陶质，保留原有形状、部件和承托关系。
summaryEn: Apply translucent celadon glaze with pooled color and fine crazing while preserving the original form, components, and grounded placement.
sampleTitleEn: Long-neck squash on a bamboo tray
samplePrompt: Natural still-life photograph of one curved long-neck tan squash resting diagonally on one shallow round woven bamboo tray. The bulb sits lower left and the narrow curved neck points upper right. A plain linen cloth occupies one table corner. Soft north-window daylight, gray-beige plaster wall, slightly elevated three-quarter view. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Full objects visible with breathing room. Natural photography, realistic materials and lighting; no text, logo, watermark, or illustration.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one elongated squash has a rounded bulb at lower left and a narrower curved neck rising right. One circular shallow tray supports it; a folded cloth remains separate at lower right. Verify the squash curve, contact region, and tray rim visibility against the generated image.
mediumAnchor: Translucent celadon ceramic glaze with subtle pooled green color and fine surface crazing over a stable ceramic body.
negative: Structural fractures, broken pieces, filled openings, or extra parts.
Painted motifs, inscriptions, decorative stands, logos, or watermarks.
Uniform jade-like translucency through the entire object.
acceptanceZh: 主体外形、数量与原有接触点不变。
开片仅位于釉面，不形成断裂或缺口。
凹处积色与边缘薄釉有可见差别。
无新增纹饰、落款或仿古污渍。
acceptanceEn: Subject shapes, counts, and contact points are unchanged.
Crazing stays within the glaze without structural breaks.
Recess pooling differs visibly from thinner edge glaze.
No motifs, inscriptions, or artificial age stains are added.

fragments.text: Recast existing solid surfaces as glazed celadon ceramic, preserving the complete silhouette, attachments, cavities, and support relationships.
Use pale gray-green glaze, deeper moss in recesses, and warm porcelain highlights without adding painted decoration.
Keep original contours soft and precise; use fine crazing lines only within the existing surface boundaries.
Show sparse irregular glaze crazing and slight pooling in depressions; cracks must not break the ceramic body.
Maintain the source light direction with broad soft glaze reflections and subdued shadows on the original support.
Keep object count, framing, scale, placement, and camera angle unchanged.
Let glaze thickness vary around edges and recesses while preserving the source's distinctive shape.
Finish with restrained vitreous sheen and handmade ceramic weight; avoid fake age stains or ornamental inscriptions.

preserve: Subject count, outer silhouette, openings, attachments, and contact points.
Source camera viewpoint, framing, relative scale, and placement.
Recognizable subject identity and existing background structure.
geometryNoteZh: 仅改变原有实体外表和材质表现，不增减部件，不改变轮廓、开口或摆放。
geometryNoteEn: Change existing solid surfaces and their material response only; retain parts, silhouettes, openings, and placement.

summaryZh: 将主体外表转译为细腻温润的玉石，通过薄处透光、低对比矿物云纹与柔和抛光表现厚度，保留原物形状。
summaryEn: Render the subject in softly polished jade with thin-edge transmission and restrained mineral clouds, retaining its original geometry.
sampleTitleEn: Folded headphones on a round table
samplePrompt: Natural product photograph of one pair of plain over-ear headphones folded neatly on a small matte gray circular table. Two oval earcups sit near the center and one curved headband arcs behind them. No cable. Soft window light from upper right, neutral studio room background, elevated three-quarter camera. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Full objects visible with breathing room. Natural photography, realistic materials and lighting; no text, logo, watermark, or illustration.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one connected headphone assembly contains two oval earcups and one curved headband with a visible interior gap. The folded earcups rest on the tabletop, and the band arcs behind them. Verify hinge visibility and the exact gap shape against the source image.
mediumAnchor: Fine-grained nephrite-like jade with gentle subsurface scattering, cloudy mineral variation, and restrained polish.
negative: Carved dragons, floral relief, symbols, tassels, or decorative pedestals.
Closed gaps, fused parts, duplicated components, or changed proportions.
Neon green glass, plastic shine, text, logos, or watermarks.
acceptanceZh: 主体数量、孔隙和部件连接保持原样。
薄缘透光强于厚体，体积可信。
矿物云纹轻微，不抢夺主体结构。
无额外雕花、配饰或底座。
acceptanceEn: Counts, gaps, and component connections remain intact.
Thin edges transmit more light than thick volumes.
Mineral clouds remain subtle and subordinate to structure.
No carved ornament, accessory, or pedestal is added.

fragments.text: Translate existing solid subject surfaces into fine-grained jade with gentle subsurface scattering, retaining all holes, gaps, and attached parts.
Use pale sage, milky ivory, and muted green-gray veins sampled as subtle mineral variation rather than decorative patterns.
Define contours through smooth rounded edges and changing thickness; do not carve new relief patterns.
Introduce restrained cloudy inclusions and fine mineral grain within solid areas, never large contrasting marble veins.
Keep source lighting; thin edges transmit softly while thick volumes remain denser and less translucent.
Preserve subject count, camera angle, framing, placement, and negative spaces between components.
Retain small functional joints and surface transitions as recognizable shapes without inventing carved ornaments.
Use a low-gloss waxy polish with softened highlights and grounded shadows, avoiding plastic opacity or emerald brilliance.

preserve: Subject count, outer silhouette, openings, attachments, and contact points.
Source camera viewpoint, framing, relative scale, and placement.
Recognizable subject identity and existing background structure.
geometryNoteZh: 仅改变原有实体外表和材质表现，不增减部件，不改变轮廓、开口或摆放。
geometryNoteEn: Change existing solid surfaces and their material response only; retain parts, silhouettes, openings, and placement.

summaryZh: 让主体覆上深色多层漆面，以柔和长条反光和边缘透色突出曲面，表现细致打磨后的温厚质感，不增添纹饰。
summaryEn: Coat the subject in deep layered lacquer with long soft reflections and subtle edge color, emphasizing polished curves without added decoration.
samplePrompt: Natural close still-life photograph of one intact cream spiral seashell lying on its side on a dark plain wooden table. Its oval opening faces front right and the spiral tip points upper left. Soft elongated window reflection from the left, charcoal background, three-quarter camera, realistic shell texture. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Full objects visible with breathing room. Natural photography, realistic materials and lighting; no text, logo, watermark, or illustration.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one spiral shell lies on a horizontal wood surface. The tip points upper left and one oval opening faces front right, creating a dark interior. The rounded body has overlapping curved ridges. Verify aperture visibility and winding direction against the image.
mediumAnchor: Deep multilayer polished lacquer with subtle warm undertones, smooth flowing reflections, and restrained surface depth.
negative: Gold leaf patterns, flowers, lettering, inlays, or decorative stands.
Mirror chrome, wet melting surfaces, thick drips, or changed silhouette.
Filled cavities, extra objects, logos, or watermarks.
acceptanceZh: 原有轮廓、开口和结构脊线仍可辨。
长条反光贴合曲面且沿原光向出现。
深漆面有层次，不成为纯黑剪影。
无滴落、熔化、金饰或新增图案。
acceptanceEn: Original contours, openings, and structural ridges stay readable.
Long reflections follow curvature and original lighting.
Dark lacquer retains depth rather than becoming a black silhouette.
No drips, melting, gilt ornament, or new patterns appear.

fragments.text: Coat existing solid surfaces with deep polished lacquer, keeping the source silhouette, aperture, ridges, and support contacts intact.
Use near-black oxblood, muted vermilion undertones, and warm reflection accents without decorative gold or painted motifs.
Preserve smooth original contour transitions and visible structural seams; do not add ornamental linework.
Show layered lacquer depth with faint hand-polished variation, avoiding visible brush strokes or heavy surface scratches.
Retain the source light direction and stretch soft highlights along curved surfaces without turning them into mirror chrome.
Keep the original framing, scale, object count, orientation, and empty spaces.
Let thin edges reveal a slight warmer undertone while keeping recesses deep and readable.
Finish as carefully polished lacquer with controlled gloss, grounded shadows, and no added ornament or display platform.

preserve: Subject count, outer silhouette, openings, attachments, and contact points.
Source camera viewpoint, framing, relative scale, and placement.
Recognizable subject identity and existing background structure.
geometryNoteZh: 仅改变原有实体外表和材质表现，不增减部件，不改变轮廓、开口或摆放。
geometryNoteEn: Change existing solid surfaces and their material response only; retain parts, silhouettes, openings, and placement.

summaryZh: 将主体表面转换为细小锤击凹面的铜质，利用暖色金属反射与局部氧化层增强手工感，保留原物的完整结构。
summaryEn: Translate the subject into copper with fine hammer dimples, warm metallic reflections, and restrained oxidation while preserving its structure.
sampleTitleEn: Red pepper on a stone counter
samplePrompt: Natural food photograph of one whole red bell pepper standing upright on a pale stone kitchen counter, its short green stem leaning left. A single detached green leaf lies behind and right. Soft daylight from a side window, warm gray wall, low three-quarter camera, fresh natural texture. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Full objects visible with breathing room. Natural photography, realistic materials and lighting; no text, logo, watermark, or illustration.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one upright lobed pepper with one short attached stem and one detached leaf behind right. The pepper has broad curved lobes divided by shallow grooves and rests directly on the counter. Verify visible lobe count and the stem direction against the generated source.
mediumAnchor: Hand-hammered copper sheet with shallow irregular dimples and modest warm oxidation in surface recesses.
negative: Turquoise corrosion covering the subject, carved motifs, or new rivets.
Crumpled foil, deep dents that alter shape, or melted edges.
Extra stems, duplicated leaves, text, logos, or watermarks.
acceptanceZh: 主体外形和细部数量与原图一致。
锤纹随曲面变化，不破坏原有轮廓。
金属反光同时表达整体体积与局部凹面。
氧化仅轻微存在，无新增铆钉或装饰。
acceptanceEn: Overall shape and detail counts match the source.
Hammer marks follow curvature without changing the silhouette.
Metal reflections describe both overall volume and local dimples.
Oxidation stays restrained, with no added rivets or decoration.

fragments.text: Recast existing solid surfaces as hand-hammered copper, preserving original contours, protrusions, component boundaries, and attachment relationships.
Use warm copper, dark reddish-brown recesses, and small pale metallic highlights; avoid broad turquoise patina.
Keep structural grooves and boundaries from the source; express edges through changing metallic reflection rather than outlines.
Cover surfaces with shallow irregular hammer dimples scaled to the object, with slightly darker recesses.
Retain the light direction; each dimple catches a restrained highlight while larger reflections describe the overall form.
Preserve framing, subject count, scale, orientation, placement, and support shadows.
Wrap hammer marks with the local surface curvature and reduce their scale near fine details.
Finish as worked copper with subtle oxidation, avoiding crumpled foil, carved decoration, or added hardware.

preserve: Subject count, outer silhouette, openings, attachments, and contact points.
Source camera viewpoint, framing, relative scale, and placement.
Recognizable subject identity and existing background structure.
geometryNoteZh: 仅改变原有实体外表和材质表现，不增减部件，不改变轮廓、开口或摆放。
geometryNoteEn: Change existing solid surfaces and their material response only; retain parts, silhouettes, openings, and placement.

summaryZh: 以方向一致的细拉丝和低饱和银灰反射重塑主体表面，突出各面的朝向与转折，保持轮廓、间隙和部件连接清晰。
summaryEn: Render the subject in satin aluminum with directional brushing and cool silver reflections that clarify planes without changing its construction.
samplePrompt: Natural product photograph of one simple unbranded articulated desk lamp on a muted blue-gray desk. Two straight arms connect a circular base to a shallow conical shade angled down left. One closed blank notepad lies at lower right. Diffuse daylight, plain off-white wall, eye-level three-quarter view, entire lamp visible. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Full objects visible with breathing room. Natural photography, realistic materials and lighting; no text, logo, watermark, or illustration.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one lamp consists of a round base, two jointed straight arms, and a conical shade aimed down left. One closed rectangular notepad lies separately lower right. The lamp's arm gaps remain open. Verify joints, arm count, and shade orientation after source generation.
mediumAnchor: Satin brushed aluminum with fine directional abrasion and anisotropic reflections aligned to individual surfaces.
negative: Added screws, vents, bevels, industrial labels, or extra joints.
Mirror chrome, glitter, rust, or coarse scratches.
Changed arm count, closed gaps, text, logos, or watermarks.
acceptanceZh: 原有部件、间隙和连接方式保持一致。
每个表面的拉丝方向清楚且符合曲面。
反光呈缎面而非镜面镀铬。
没有新增技术标识、螺丝或结构细节。
acceptanceEn: Original parts, gaps, and connections remain intact.
Brushing directions read clearly and follow local surfaces.
Reflections remain satin rather than mirror chrome.
No technical labels, screws, or structural details are invented.

fragments.text: Translate existing solid surfaces into satin brushed aluminum while preserving all component shapes, joints, gaps, and attachments.
Use cool silver, neutral graphite shadows, and soft pearl highlights with minimal color saturation.
Keep straight edges and curved boundaries faithful; do not add bevels, seams, screws, or technical markings.
Align fine brushing with each surface's construction direction; curved parts receive smoothly wrapping grain.
Retain illumination direction and create elongated anisotropic highlights across the brushing, avoiding mirror-like reflections.
Keep original subject count, framing, perspective, placement, and surrounding negative space.
Maintain readable joints and overlapping parts through local reflection changes rather than invented hardware.
Finish with consistent satin roughness and subtle grain; avoid chrome polish, glitter, or heavily scratched distressing.

preserve: Subject count, outer silhouette, openings, attachments, and contact points.
Source camera viewpoint, framing, relative scale, and placement.
Recognizable subject identity and existing background structure.
geometryNoteZh: 仅改变原有实体外表和材质表现，不增减部件，不改变轮廓、开口或摆放。
geometryNoteEn: Change existing solid surfaces and their material response only; retain parts, silhouettes, openings, and placement.

summaryZh: 将主体转化为半透明树脂体，以极薄色层、柔和内折射和清晰边缘表现封存感，保持原形，不封入额外花草或摆件。
summaryEn: Recast the subject as translucent resin with thin color strata and soft internal refraction, preserving its form without decorative inclusions.
samplePrompt: Natural macro still-life photograph of one open brown pine cone resting sideways on folded unbleached linen. Its narrow tip points upper right; overlapping scales cast small shadows. A plain warm gray backdrop and soft side daylight, close three-quarter view, whole pine cone visible, no other objects. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Full objects visible with breathing room. Natural photography, realistic materials and lighting; no text, logo, watermark, or illustration.
sampleAnalysis: Planned source: one elongated pine cone lies diagonally with its tip upper right. Many overlapping scales surround a central axis, with narrow dark gaps between scales. Folded linen supports the cone. Verify actual scale arrangement and contact points after generation.
mediumAnchor: Translucent cast resin with restrained thin color strata following the object's volume and subtle internal optical depth.
negative: Embedded flowers, leaves, insects, glitter, or unrelated objects.
Solid block encasing the whole scene, filled gaps, or fused scales.
Drips, melting, extra parts, text, logos, or watermarks.
acceptanceZh: 原有鳞片、缝隙和轮廓仍清楚可辨。
薄色层沿实体体积变化，不横跨空隙。
树脂具有内折射和厚度差异。
无新增封入物、亮片或整体封装方块。
acceptanceEn: Original scales, gaps, and silhouette remain legible.
Thin color strata follow solid volumes without crossing gaps.
Resin conveys internal refraction and varying thickness.
No inclusions, glitter, or enclosing display block are added.

fragments.text: Recast existing solid surfaces as translucent layered resin, retaining the subject's silhouette, overlapping parts, gaps, and contact points.
Use pale amber, smoky violet-gray, and clear warm highlights in thin restrained internal layers.
Preserve existing edges and part separations; use refractive thickness rather than drawn outlines to define them.
Show delicate internal strata and sparse microbubbles without adding flowers, glitter, insects, or decorative inclusions.
Retain source lighting with soft internal refraction, brighter thin edges, and subdued caustics on the original support.
